name: Slitherfang

provenance.parley: parley: null, DELIBERATELY. Seam S13: 'Beasts and mindless things are exempt — they have no parley and Souls owns them entirely.' The exemption is a declaration, not an omission: the input is dropped with a named reason and a PARLEY_EXEMPT event, so a critic can tell a designed exemption from a forgotten one.
provenance.winded: RI-CMB09 §4 enemy symmetry: beasts have no stamina bar and instead go WINDED after >= 3 attacks in 6 s, with the same tell and the same x0.50 poise, for 75 f@60.
provenance.frame_data: PROVISIONAL. Owner RI-AI05 / wave-1 piece W1-12.

_armour_rating_note: Seam S19's consuming system for `corrode` (RI-MAG06 §B: "the rating falls"). A flat subtraction from every incoming damage number, applied in combat/resolve.js at the one site damage is computed. It was 0 everywhere in wave 1, which meant `corrode` had nothing to corrode and measured NOT_OBSERVED. Provisional: RI-CMB01 owns armour as a fight quantity and may re-derive every figure here.
